form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Handwritten form, clear hand. PAGES ARE OUT OF ORDER IN THE PDF and the locator therefore found no summary page (it fell back to the last page, which is a Schedule A sheet). The filer hand-numbered every sheet: PDF p1 is the cover marked 'Pg 8 of 8', PDF p2 is the SUMMARY PAGE marked 'Pg 1 of 8', PDF p3 is a Schedule B marked 'Pg 7 of 8', PDF p8 is a Schedule A marked 'Pg 2 of 8'. Pages 2-7 were rendered for this read because the summary image was missing from the pre-rendered set. CENTS CONVENTION: this filer writes cents as a raised superscript after the dollars (A '26,522' with a superscript 23, D '43,477' superscript 05, E '50,847' superscript 22, F '71,798' superscript 23, G '28,321' superscript 18) - transcribed with a decimal point. Boxes B and C are written with NO cents at all ('45,276', '52,096') and are preserved that way, not padded. This revision labels the close box 'G'; it prints no 'v.' version string, so form_version is ''. Schedule totals on the itemization sheets corroborate the summary: Schedule A 'Total Contributions Received $45,276' matches Box B (that page's subtotal figure was struck through and rewritten - the surviving value is 19,776 for the page subtotal and 45,276 for the report total), and Schedule B 'Total Expenditures Made $43,477.05' matches Box D. Office 'Commission Seat B' agrees with index.csv.

Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 52,096 and is a CUMULATIVE figure, never summed as an increment. Box E 'Expenditures Made Year to Date' prints 50,847.22 and is CUMULATIVE, never summed. IN-KIND: the same five gifts appear again on PDF p3 with the In-Kind box ticked (1,600 + 1,000 + 1,182 + 6,843 + 2,001 = 12,626.00) and are INSIDE the stated 43,477.05 — monetary-only gives 30,851.05 and fails. TWO CELLS WERE ESCALATED AND ARE THE ONLY DOUBTFUL FIGURES: PDF p6 row 2 (12.84) and PDF p6 row 14 (73.59), both with over-written / struck cents; that sheet's other 13 rows sum to 6,290.33, so the pair must total 86.43. Row 2's last cents digit is a '4' drawn OVER a struck '7' (handwritten correction governs), fixing 12.84 and therefore 73.59 for row 14, whose struck cents show a '9' loop under the diagonal. Both rows carry confidence 'low' and needs_review=1 because arithmetic alone admits other splits of 86.43.

itemized.notes: PAGES ARE BOUND OUT OF ORDER AND THE FILER FOLIATED EVERY SHEET BY HAND — this is the wave's clearest demonstration that a page ordinal locates nothing. PDF p1 is the COVER, hand-marked 'Pg 8 of 8'; PDF p2 is the SUMMARY PAGE, hand-marked 'Pg 1 of 8'; PDF p3-p6 are four Schedule B sheets marked Pg 7 / 6 / 5 / 4 of 8 (so they run BACKWARDS through the PDF); PDF p7-p8 are two Schedule A sheets marked Pg 3 and Pg 2 of 8. Every page was classified from its own printed heading. `line_no` follows the FILER'S OWN foliation order within each side (Schedule A: Pg 2 sheet = PDF p8 first, then Pg 3 = PDF p7; Schedule B: Pg 4 = PDF p6, Pg 5 = PDF p5, Pg 6 = PDF p4, Pg 7 = PDF p3), while `page`/`row` are the absolute PDF page and the measured band index. FORM: modern_boxAF, title 'Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates', Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor Elections Division masthead, and it prints NO 'v.' revision string anywhere — so the 2022 stock seen here is an UNVERSIONED revision, not v.4.20 / v.2.22 / v.12.23. It differs from the ADDENDUM I3 v.4.20 map in two ways worth recording: the close box IS LETTERED 'G' ('Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)'), where v.4.20 leaves it unlettered; and Schedule B's columns are Date / Provider-Vendor / PURPOSE / Amount / In-Kind, i.e. a real Purpose column plus an IN-KIND TICK COLUMN on BOTH schedules. Schedule A's third column is headed 'City and State' and prints no street line at all, so the privacy reduction is native to the form on this side and no address was ever in reach; expenditure rows carry no address field. NO CHECKLIST DECOY IS BOUND INTO THIS FILING — all 8 pages are the report itself (1 cover + 1 summary + 6 schedule sheets), and the summary page carries real figures in every box. CENTS CONVENTION: this filer writes cents as a raised superscript with no decimal point (26,522 with a raised 23), and writes Boxes B and C with NO cents at all (45,276 / 52,096) — preserved as printed, not padded. Both sides close EXACTLY, and the cover ladder closes too: A 26,522.23 + B 45,276 = F 71,798.23 and F - D = 28,321.18 = G, all as printed. Page-face candidate 'Bill Lee', office written 'Commission Seat B' — both agree with index.csv. Report type: 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election', not an amendment (the No box is ticked), signed and filed 6/21/2022.
